predictions: P-A (spectral shape, falsifiable): over our stamped MAIN-ONLY window [-7.338, +30.455] s the window-integrated AIC winner is a CURVED one-break family (Band / CPL / SBPL) with Ep between the flnc-Band frame (151 keV) and the peak-slice CPL frame (239 keV), i.e. 100 <= Ep <= 320 keV. FALSIFIED if the winner's Ep < 80 keV or > 400 keV, or if a straight PL wins by dAIC >= 10 (catalog PL is the worst of four by a wide margin: redchisq 1.636 vs 1.238-1.293).

P-A2 (high-energy tail, falsifiable): the catalog constrains beta = -1.962 +/- 0.088 with BGO b0 in the fit, i.e. a HARD tail (nuFnu ~ E^0.04 above Ep). Predict models carrying a high-energy power law (Band / SBPL / DSBPL) beat CPL window-integrated. FALSIFIED if CPL beats Band by dAIC >= 10 window-integrated.

P-A3 (Ep degeneracy warning, falsifiable as a procedure): because beta sits at the -2 boundary, Ep is only weakly pinned - the four catalog models disagree by 1.6x in Ep (151/227/239 keV) while all sit within d(redchisq) < 0.4. Predict our per-block Ep uncertainties are correspondingly large (>=15% fractional) in at least half the blocks, and predict at least one block triggers the L9 BOUND_CAPPED / wide-Ep-cap diagnosis. FALSIFIED if every block returns Ep to better than 10% with no bound interaction.

P-B (null-streak baseline, falsifiable): NO published BB / photosphere / quasi-thermal claim exists for this burst anywhere in its 5-paper record. Predict the union rule (LRT_BANDBB_BAND >= 9.2 AND kT > 1.05 AND LRT_CPLBB_CPL >= 9.2 - BOTH nested tests) fires in ZERO blocks. Any significant-BB block is an UNPUBLISHED-DECISION finding to be scored against the expert band, not a literature reconciliation.

P-C (two-break, falsifiable): the catalog's one-break SBPL (Ebreak = 43.1 +/- 9.4 keV) and Band are statistically TIED (redchisq 1.2377 vs 1.2479 at equal dof) and no two-break evidence is published. Predict DSBPL does NOT win by dAIC >= 10 in any block of this moderate burst (PF1024 = 4.2 ph/cm2/s). A DSBPL win would be a genuine unpublished discovery candidate and MUST first clear the L8 default-seed artifact check.

P-D (temporal, falsifiable): Maccary+2025 report Npeaks = 2 and FWHMmin = 3.02 (-0.78/+1.06) s over the whole light curve; Golkhou+2015 put dt_min < 0.203 s. Predict our block decomposition over the MAIN-ONLY window yields >= 2 significant blocks, and that our MVT-equivalent lands in [0.1, 4] s depending on estimator. FALSIFIED by a single-block decomposition of the main pulse, or by an MVT outside that decade-wide band. NOTE: the consensus-era archival panel (different window, src(-3,42)) gave 3 blocks - disclosed in freeze_hygiene, NOT used as the prediction.

P-E (component-coverage trap, procedural - the dominant hazard on this burst): our window EXCLUDES the T0-120 s precursor that Bhat+2016 explicitly INCLUDED in the duration analysis. Therefore predict our window-integrated 10-1000 keV fluence comes out BELOW the catalog's 1.42e-05 erg/cm2, and predict any 'our T90 disagrees with the catalog' statement is an artifact of coverage, not of method. Any duration/fluence diff MUST first re-align (i) component coverage (precursor+main vs main-only), (ii) energy band (our fits vs their 50-300 keV durations, with T90 ~ E^-0.20 per Qin+2013 which Bhat+2016 itself cites), and (iii) detector set (their NaI-only 0+1+3+4 for durations, n0+n3+b0 for spectra, vs our n0,n1,n3,n4,b0).

P-F (background validity, falsifiable): the pre-burst background windows open at T0-83 s (n0), -98.3 s (n1,n3), -103.0 s (n4), -100.0 s (b0) - the earliest of them sits only ~17 s after the localized precursor. Predict the precursor does NOT measurably contaminate the fitted background (no systematic positive residual at the early edge of the pre-window). FALSIFIED if the polynomial background shows a coherent excess in the first ~10 s of any pre-window, in which case the pre-window inner/outer edges must be revisited before any block-level flux is quoted.
